resources.name: Low-Rank Potential (LRP) implementation (mlip-2)

access.notes: Open-source code for tensor-train LRP fitting.

resources.notes: Provides LRP training and energy evaluation for MC.

resources.name: DFT code (Quantum ESPRESSO)

access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT package that can replace VASP for the required calculations (PBE functional).

resources.notes: The original paper used VASP; any open-source DFT code producing comparable PBE results is acceptable.

resources.name: PBE pseudopotentials for V, Co, Ni

access.notes: Standard PBE PAW or ultrasoft pseudopotentials suitable for transition metals.

resources.notes: Agent must choose appropriate pseudos for V, Co, Ni.

resources.name: SQS generation tool (ATAT or custom)

access.notes: ATAT (Alloy Theoretic Automated Toolkit) or any custom script for special quasirandom structures.

resources.notes: Needed to produce initial training SQS configurations.

resources.name: Monte Carlo simulation code

access.notes: Agent can implement a canonical Monte Carlo code (lattice gas with Metropolis algorithm) using the LRP for energy calculation.

resources.notes: Custom implementation acceptable; must output trajectory data for analysis.
